name: m4-branch-4pt-scala
description: Four points for retronym/scala#231: Scala 2.13.18 (the release current on 1 October, with its STARR bumped to 2.13.19-M1 because 2.13.17's cannot compile the library on JDK 26), upstream 2.13.x after it (at `57587f108e`), the boundary after my upstreamed PRs (scala/scala#11369, #11375, #11307, #11312, #11376, #11389, #11390), and the tip with the retronym/scala PRs (#148, #207, #210, #200, #205, #206) and the Symbol.filter commits on top. The three commits after 2.13.18 are synthetic, built from the real trees, so the campaign checks each point out in its own worktree.

Real commit ranges, since the points after 2.13.18 are synthetic commits with the trees of the real ones: [2.13.18 to the upstream base](https://github.com/scala/scala/compare/v2.13.18...57587f108e9570c565e08f04009cbdb090cec294) (a STARR bump aside); [upstream base to the boundary](https://github.com/retronym/scala/compare/57587f108e9570c565e08f04009cbdb090cec294...4cb53491ddc1e72fe780b34148378c52dae083bc), the scala/scala PRs; [boundary to the tip](https://github.com/retronym/scala/compare/4cb53491ddc1e72fe780b34148378c52dae083bc...6101d220ca9ae3e3c92261b7a30127e14e35b072), the Symbol.filter commits and the retronym/scala PRs. The tip is the branch of [retronym/scala#231](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/231).

On the M4, 3 rounds (round 1 copied from `m4-branch-3pt-scala` for three of the four points), xctrace ipc; release optimizer settings; patched JDK 26; corpus compiled against JDK 25's API; 8G heap, 6 x 20 s warmup, 6 x 20 s measured. Same settings as `m4-branch-3pt-scala`, which this replaces so that 2.13.18 is the baseline.
